data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that visualizes JSON data and tree structures.
data.what_it_does: Visualizes JSON and custom tree structures where any node can be a widget. Provides standard and high-performance recycler widget variants for handling large JSON files.
use_when: You need to display or inspect JSON data inside your Flutter app.
You want to render custom tree structures with interactive nodes.
avoid_when: You need complex data manipulation or editing capabilities beyond simple visualization.
You are working with extremely large JSON structures without using the recycler variants.
strengths: Supports both standard views and high-performance recycler widgets/slivers for large JSONs.
Customizable node icons, indentations, and colors for different data types.
weaknesses: Standard `CrJsonWidget` displays all children as a simple ListView and performs poorly with huge JSONs.
Requires explicit height constraints when using `CrJsonRecyclerWidget`.
